rows.label: tlk70000062_01_msg0001
rows.name:
How's the air out here in all this
nature? Different from Iira, right?

rows.label: tlk70000062_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Gula is rich in water and nature, and
its climate is mild too.

rows.label: tlk70000062_01_msg0003
rows.name:
But if you wander too far inland,
you may run into incredibly strong
monsters.

rows.label: tlk70000062_01_msg0004
rows.name:
You'll want to keep an eye out if
you stray too far from the road.
